title: kbgit.py check-lanes and the pre-push hook
goal: kblane.py check_lanes(range, associate) lists the unmerged code-lane commits; kbgit.py check-lanes reads the range as check-trailers does (GitLab CI: CI_COMMIT_BEFORE_SHA..CI_COMMIT_SHA, only CI_COMMIT_SHA when before is all zeros; elsewhere @{upstream}..HEAD) and asks the forge from the CI variables with urllib, or with --forge none treats every code-lane commit as unmerged; kbgit.py hook pre-push refuses a push to the integration main that carries a code-lane commit, sync's own push included; TestCheckLanes in _tools/test_kblane.py covers a direct code commit, a merged one, a merge commit, an API error (exit 2) and the hook refusal
notes: No test calls a real forge: the client is tested against an injected opener or a stub server on loopback.
